title: AI based detection and prediction of eating events using Continuous Glucose Monitoring: A comprehensive review
excerpt: This comprehensive review examines AI-based methods for detecting and predicting eating events from continuous glucose monitoring data, covering model-based, machine-learning, deep-learning, and multimodal approaches.
citation: Muhammad Kashif, Chunzhuo Wang, Sergio Flesca, and Pierangelo Veltri. (2026). "AI based detection and prediction of eating events using Continuous Glucose Monitoring: A comprehensive review." Biomedical Signal Processing and Control, 127(B), 111207. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.bspc.2026.111207

title: Meal Episode Detection from Continuous Glucose Monitoring Using a BiLSTM Sliding-Window and Constraint-Based Decoding
excerpt: This work presents a physiological time-series framework for meal-episode detection from continuous glucose monitoring data using BiLSTM-based sequence learning and constraint-based episode decoding.
citation: Muhammad Kashif, Chunzhuo Wang, Sergio Flesca, and Pierangelo Veltri. (2026). "Meal Episode Detection from Continuous Glucose Monitoring Using a BiLSTM Sliding-Window and Constraint-Based Decoding." 34th European Signal Processing Conference (EUSIPCO 2026).

title: Task-Conditioned PEFT with Prompt-Aligned ASR Error Structure Fusion for Parkinson's Speech Assessment
